---
title: Home
---

This example demonstrates a sidebar populated **automatically** from
a directory walk, rather than enumerated by hand.

The relevant `_quarto.yml` fragment:

```yaml
website:
  sidebar:
    contents:
      - section: "Posts"
        contents:
          - auto: posts/
```

Quarto walks `posts/`, finds every renderable `.qmd`, and turns each
into a sidebar entry. Pages with `draft: true` in their frontmatter
are excluded. Order is controlled by an `order:` frontmatter key
(numeric); when no `order:` is set, entries fall back to
title-alphabetical.

See the posts directory for a sample, including one out-of-natural-
sort page and one excluded draft.
